title: Alkahest Drops mob file (format 1)
description: A file in data/<namespace>/mob_drops/: a drop file (drops) or a removal file (removals), never both. Docs: https://jaffh-dev.github.io/alkahest-wiki/mods/alkahest-drops/

$schema.description: This schema, for editor autocomplete. Ignored by the game.

block.description: Mob files use entity; block is for block_drops files. The file is skipped.

drops.description: The drops this file adds. A drop file must not also have removals.

on.description: Removal files only: the trigger whose drops the file removes (death by default). In drop files, set on per drop.

removals.description: A file is either a drop file or a removal file. The file is skipped.

on.description: Ignored in drop files (warning): set on per drop.

entity.description: A player's drops are their inventory: removal files cannot target players.

dropBehavior.description: How the count is chosen inside count: uniform, fixed_rolls, chained_rolls, max_health, or damage_taken (hit drops only).

type.description: uniform: any count from min to max. fixed_rolls: a fixed number of independent rolls. chained_rolls: rolls until the first failure. max_health: scales with the mob's max health. damage_taken: scales with the damage of a hit ("on": "hit" only).

drop.description: One drop. Needs item (or "experience": true), chance, count and drop_behavior.

item.description: Item to drop. An item of a mod that is not installed skips the drop with a warning.

experience.description: true makes this an experience drop: count is the amount of experience. Use instead of item.

functions.description: Loot functions applied to the dropped stack, in order, after count and nbt.

first_kill.description: Drop once per player, the first time, ignoring the chance.

first_break.description: Block files only: mob files use first_kill (ignored, warning).

per_player.description: Every player who damaged the mob gets their own roll, locked to them. Death drops only.

interval.description: Periodic drops: ticks between drops (default 6000 = 5 minutes), 1 or more.

cooldown.description: Hit drops: ticks to wait after a drop before the next hit can drop (default 0).

pity.description: Lightning and periodic drops have no player: pity is ignored (warning).

first_kill.description: Lightning and periodic drops have no player: first_kill is an error.

enchant_bonus.description: Lightning and periodic drops read no enchantment (warning).

per_player.description: per_player only applies to death drops (warning).

function.description: looting_enchant and an enchant_bonus entry for Looting both apply (warning).
apply_bonus reads the tool, which mob drops never have (warning).
